name: La Famiglia Pizzeria & Restaurant
description: A family Italian pizzeria and restaurant in downtown Glen Cove, next to the movie theater. It hosts occasional dinner music nights, such as a Beatles and classic rock duo, and reservations are suggested.

dancing.notes: Music nights here are dinner shows in a cozy dining room, and listings stress calling ahead for a reservation. We found no mention of a dance floor or of people dancing. In July the town's Downtown Sounds series has also used a small outdoor stage on School Street in front of the restaurant.

evidence.note: Band calendar lists a duo playing Beatles and classic rock at the restaurant, calls it cozy and says reservations are a must.
Downtown business group lists a live music dinner night from 6 to 9 PM with a number to call for reservations.
Summer concert page says a second stage was set up on School Street in front of La Famiglia for July 2026 shows.
